settings.title: 80% of dogs develop gingivitis by the age of 3

settings.text:
Have you noticed bad breath, plaque, or tartar on your dog’s teeth? That’s often the beginning of a chain reaction that quickly gets worse.

Plaque that is left untreated hardens into tartar – something neither chews nor brushing can remove. This leads to inflammation, pain, and bacteria that can spread throughout the body. In the worst case, the heart and other organs are affected – and your dog’s life is shortened. 💔

With FreshSmile Kit you can stop this development in time.

Remove tartar at home – safely, quietly, and without expensive vet visits. In just a few minutes a week, you can give your dog healthier teeth and a happier life.

settings.title: The same quality as at the vet – but easy at home!

settings.text:
At the vet, special tools are used to remove tartar – often under anesthesia and at high costs.

FreshSmile™ uses the same type of technology, but is developed to be safe and easy in a home environment.

In just a few minutes a week, you can give your dog the same care as at the vet – without stress, risk, or expensive bills.

settings.title: A healthier mouth in just minutes

settings.text:
FreshSmile uses sonic vibration technology – up to 31,000 vibrations per minute.

That means:

✅ It breaks down and removes plaque & tartar directly on the teeth

✅ It only activates on hard surfaces (teeth) – never on the gums

✅ That makes it gentle, safe, and low-risk, even for sensitive dogs

The result is cleaner teeth, fresher breath, and a happier dog – without stress or pain.

settings.title: You may also be interested in:

settings.heading: Is it safe for my dog?
settings.row_content: Yes, FreshSmile Kit is designed for home use and only works on hard tooth surfaces – not on the gums. This makes it very safe and gentle to use.

settings.heading: Does it hurt the dog?
settings.row_content: No, the treatment is completely painless when used as instructed. The device only vibrates against the teeth and does not damage the gums. Most dogs adapt quickly.

settings.heading: Does it work for all breeds and sizes?
settings.row_content: Yes, FreshSmile Kit is suitable for all dog breeds and sizes – from small Chihuahuas to large breeds like German Shepherds.

settings.heading: Is it safe to use on puppies and older dogs?
settings.row_content: Yes, but puppies should wait until they have their permanent teeth. Older dogs can use it just like younger ones, but extra care should be taken if their gums are sensitive.

settings.heading: How often should I use FreshSmile Kit?
settings.row_content: We recommend 1–2 times per week. That’s enough to keep tartar away and prevent dental problems.

settings.heading: What if my dog is sensitive or afraid?
settings.row_content: Start slowly and let your dog get used to the sound and feeling. Try short sessions at first and reward with treats and praise afterwards.

settings.heading: Can I really remove tartar at home as effectively as a vet?
settings.row_content: Vets often use anesthesia and special instruments. FreshSmile Kit is not a replacement for veterinary care, but it is an effective way to remove plaque and tartar at home – which helps reduce the need for expensive cleanings.

settings.heading: What if I’m not satisfied with the results?
settings.row_content: We offer a 100-day satisfaction guarantee. If you’re not satisfied, you can return the product and get your money back – completely risk-free.
